counterexamples: Claims that do not overlap in time behave as before.

defects.evidence: dispatcher.py claim now tests membership before taking the lock and does not re-check inside it.
defects.fix_or_counterexample: Check and assign inside one locked block.
defects.impact: Both receive True and run the job; the second silently replaces the first as owner.
defects.match_criteria: Identify the membership check outside the lock without a re-check, or the resulting double claim.
defects.trigger: Two workers claim the same unowned job at the same time.
